# Every `extern "C"` entry point the C ABI exports, one per line, sorted.
#
# The surface a host binding declares in its own language, as data rather than
# as Rust source. Three readers pin it: a `flz_core_ffi` test asserts the
# crate's exports are exactly these in both directions; `sdk/php`'s
# `AbiSurfaceTest` asserts its `cdef` declares exactly these; and
# `sdk/node/test/native.test.mjs` asserts the addon's declared surface names
# nothing else. A binding that reads the crate's source instead cannot run
# outside a checkout of it, which is the whole reason this file exists.
#
# Adding an entry point: teach `flz_core_ffi/src/lib.rs` or `local.rs`, add it
# here, and declare it in every host binding that spells the surface: one
# change, every SDK (docs/architecture/runner.md).

flz_core_effect_end
flz_core_effect_release
flz_core_error_document
flz_core_init_error
flz_core_last_error

flz_core_local_next_output
